selection.reason: The rear position, stop and reversing lamps are light-signalling devices covered by R148, which consolidates R7 and R23.
The integrated retro-reflector needs approval as a retro-reflective device (Class IA/IB) under R150, which consolidates R3.

R48 sets how the rear position, stop and reversing lamps and the rear retro-reflector are installed on M1 vehicles, including number, position, geometric visibility, orientation and electrical connections.
The LED modules on a PCB, with their driver electronics, make the lamp an electrical/electronic sub-assembly subject to EMC emission and immunity requirements.
The rear lamp forms part of the M1 vehicle's external surface, so its lens and housing must meet the external-projection requirements on edges, radii and protrusions.
verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): R128 applies only if the lamp uses replaceable standardised LED light source categories rather than non-replaceable LED modules.
Its position and stop lamp provisions are consolidated into R148, which is selected instead.
Its reversing lamp provisions are consolidated into R148, which is selected instead.
Its retro-reflector provisions are consolidated into R150, which is selected instead.
The specification lists no rear fog lamp function.
The specification lists no direction indicator function.

note: Claude-Reihe: Standard + optional, Referenz Standard (E024/E033-hs-c, Mittel 0.718)
